title: fix(spec): the tool.requiresConfirmation guidance names the one pair REST /actions asks ai.exposed of
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoWK5rFW1SUGSkDw9iatZE4f)_

Part of #32924 (item 1 only; item 2, whether REST also asks `confirm: true`, stays with the maintainer and keeps the card open)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none owed — `skills/**` never says REST `/actions` is not `ai.exposed`-gated (its `requiresConfirmation` hits teach the action-level flag and the tool-level removal, both still true); in `content/docs/**` the only stale spot was `permissions/system-context.mdx` row 57, fixed here. `ui/actions.mdx` (the `'rest'` posture row), `ai/actions-as-tools.mdx` and `ai/connect-mcp.mdx` already state the AI-service-account rules correctly.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：工具上写 `requiresConfirmation` 时报错里给作者的那段说明，原来说「REST `/actions` 不读 `ai.exposed`」；现在改为「只在一种情况下读：AI 服务账号经 `type: 'flow'` 动作启动 `runAs: 'system'` 的流程，此时只要求作者的 AI 授权，不要求确认」，其余照旧。权限文档 system-context 第 57 行补上这条 AI 服务账号规则；`os migrate meta` 对已删除的工具 `requiresConfirmation` 给出的升级说明（17 版语义迁移条目）同样改正，并说明代表某个人的调用仍需作者自己把关、AI 服务账号自身在每道动作门都被拒。
- 为什么改：PR #32912（已合并，随 18.4.0 发版）让 REST 动作路由对这一组合读 `ai.exposed`，原句随版本发出会误导写 AI 动作的作者。
- 风险与回滚：只改文字，schema 接受与拒绝的内容不变（`Clause-②: no`）；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/ai/tool.zod.ts`（`requiresConfirmation` 那段说明的第 (1) 条边界）；`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/17.tool-requires-confirmation-retired.ts`（`replacement` 与验收说明两句）；`content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` 第 57 行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/ai/tool-confirmation-prescription-tense.pin.test.ts`，应见全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。第 2 项（REST 是否也要求 `confirm: true`）仍待你在卡上定夺。

## What changes

**The prescription.** `TOOL_RETIRED_KEY_GUIDANCE.requiresConfirmation` in `packages/spec/src/ai/tool.zod.ts` is the message an author meets when a tool still declares `requiresConfirmation` (the `.strict()` `ToolSchema` rejects it). Its first bound said REST `/actions` "is NOT `ai.exposed`-gated". Since #32912 that is untrue for one pair. The bound now reads:

> (1) The enforced set is the doors that ask every action for the author's `ai.exposed` opt-in — today the action door reached from the MCP `run_action` tool. REST `/actions` reads `ai.exposed` in one case only (an AI service account starting a `type: 'flow'` action whose flow declares `runAs: 'system'` needs the opt-in there), and that check asks for the opt-in alone, not a confirmation; for a person's call REST `/actions` sits OUTSIDE this gate, so a human in front of that route is still yours to arrange.

The account rule that follows it (an AI service account never confirms for itself and is refused at every action door, REST included) is unchanged. The source comment above the entry names the runtime rule it now describes.

**Both halves read off the code at `c54a23d2`:**
- REST reads the opt-in for that pair: `packages/runtime/src/flow-start-admission.ts#flowStartRefusal` rule 2, `flow.runAs === 'system' && isAiServiceAccount(executionContext) && door.aiExposed !== true` → `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`; `dispatchFlowAction` (`action-execution.ts`, shared by the REST actions route and MCP `run_action`) hands `{ aiExposed: actionIsAiExposed(action) }`.
- The confirmation gate is still not on REST for a person: `domains/actions.ts` runs the admitted sequence under `posture: 'rest'`, and `admitResolvedAction` asks `actionConfirmationRefusal` only under `'ai'` or for an AI service account. The pin `ai/tool-confirmation-prescription-tense.pin.test.ts` asserts that relation and stays green.

**Docs.** `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row 57 (what the system principal bypasses at a flow start) gains the AI-service-account rule beside the elevated self-triggered start and `requiredPermissions` (comment 6839421711). Prose only; the row's anchors and function list are unchanged.

**Generated artefacts.** The describe string feeds none: it is a parse-error message, not a `.describe()` on a schema field, so no JSON schema, `content/docs/references/**` page or authorable-surface shard carries it. `check:generated` against a dist built from this head: all 14 artefacts up to date.

**The upgrade guidance** (seat rework, file surface amended in comment 6846193569). `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/17.tool-requires-confirmation-retired.ts`, the entry `os migrate meta` reports for a tool still carrying the key, carried the same sentence twice. Its `replacement` (printed alone by `os migrate meta` and the upgrade guide) now says REST `/actions` reads `ai.exposed` only of an AI service account starting a `runAs: 'system'` flow action (asking for the opt-in, not a confirmation) and sits outside the gate for a person's call or one an agent makes on a person's behalf, while an AI service account acting for itself is refused a gated action at every action door, REST `/actions` included (contract review S1, record 6846718400). Its acceptance text says the same, and replaces "an agent holding an API key on that route is still yours to put a human in front of" with: the confirmation gate is not enforced there, so a person or an agent acting on a person's behalf on that route is still yours to put a human in front of (an AI service account acting for itself is refused a gated action at every action door; review N2 dropped "with an API key", since that principal is the OAuth-delegated client). No generated artefact carries the entry's text (`check:generated`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:upgrade-guide` green).

**Changeset.** `.changeset/32924-requires-confirmation-describe.md`, `@objectstack/spec` patch.

## Tests

No new test. The existing pin already ties this text to the runtime door in both directions, and it keeps passing with the rewording (`ai.exposed` bound, REST `/actions` carve-out, account rule, `REST \`/actions\` included`, `unverifiable caller claim`). Prose only, so no ablation.

## Acceptance notes

- Ruling surface grep (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`): `tool.zod.ts` 0 hits; `system-context.mdx` hits at rows 6b, 21, 23f, 31, 57, 62 and the ruling sections (L285, L316–337, L369, L446). Only row 57 is edited, and it cites ruling 6812617393 letter C, the ruling the new sentence restates.
- The 16→17 semantic migration entry was first left out of scope and reported; the seat amended the file surface (comment 6846193569) and it is fixed here, see What changes.
- The two reds on the first head `4379cff9` (Test UI, TypeScript Type Check) were aggregator jobs reading `cancelled` shards and lanes after the rework push superseded that head; neither log holds a test or tsc failure.
- PR #32966 (Tier H) also edits `system-context.mdx`; this PR touches row 57's text only.
- Item 2 of the card (S2: whether REST asks `confirm: true` of an AI service account) is not implemented in either direction.

## Verification

All readings at head `a8f3da02`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0), then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/migrations/ src/ai/`: Test Files 21 passed (21), Tests 604 passed (604), including `tool-confirmation-prescription-tense.pin.test.ts` and `semantic-relevance.test.ts`.
- Consumer of the migration entry: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration --maxWorkers=2 test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts` (after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build`): Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 3 passed (3).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:generated` (against the dist built from this change): all 14 generated artefacts up to date; the working tree stayed clean.
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 103 families (the entry adds `check:spec-changes`, `check:upgrade-guide`, `check:cli-command-ids`, `check:query-options-erasure`), all run with `</dev/null` after a `pnpm turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter='./packages/**'` (81/81), exit codes captured before any pipe; every one exit 0. Reconciliation `--ran`: `103 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 103 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 103 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.
- Consumers: the text is a parse-error message of `ToolSchema`; no package parses its wording (the runtime pin reads the runtime, not this string), so no consumer test is owed beyond the spec pin. `test:repo` and the full farm are CI's.
